comments.body: Idk who you are, but you obviously need to be up front about who you are in game to be taken seriously. I have been the deputy director of elysium for 2 years and i assure you saul has very little interest in competitive pvp. ItI was the one that turned the companies dfocus to maritime. I had to drag saul in that direction kicking and screaming. it was no small task. There was no motivation for him to resort to such measures. If you have genuine concerns about such things, feel free to contact me or even better, saul, to discuss them. Dont make wild accusations. unless you simply enjoy causing random problems for people for no reason, if that is the case, carry on.
